Adding the sensitive-role guidance draft. Two quick items to confirm:
1) Routing: For roles with access to customer PII or cryptographic keys, the manager must mark the form "Sensitive" and the packet gets sent to Neha + Legal for redaction review before wider calibration.
2) Distribution: Redacted packet goes to managers and exec calibrators only; unredacted stays in HR secure folder accessible to only HR leads and Legal.

I've attached a short guideline PDF (sensitive_role_routing_guidelines.pdf) with the proposed approval flow and a suggested redaction checklist. Megan — can you confirm if HR Partners can run a rapid redaction validation for the first week? We may need a 24–48 hour SLT in week one.

Attachment: sensitive_role_routing_guidelines.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
